006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.StringItemImpl;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * An atomic Metapath item containing a text data value.
017 */
018public interface IStringItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
019  /**
020   * Get the type information for this item.
021   *
022   * @return the type information
023   */
024  @NonNull
025  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IStringItem> type() {
026    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.STRING.getItemType();
027  }
028
029  @Override
030  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends IStringItem> getType() {
031    return type();
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Construct a new item using the provided string {@code value}.
036   *
037   * @param value
038   *          a string value that must conform to Metaschema string validation
039   *          rules
040   * @return the new item
041   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
042   *           if the value fails string validation
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  static IStringItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
046    try {
047      return new StringItemImpl(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.STRING.parse(value));
048    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
049      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
050          null,
051          String.format("Invalid string value '%s'. %s",
052              value,
053              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
054          ex);
055    }
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Encode this string as base64.
060   *
061   * @return the base64 encoded text
062   */
063  default IBase64BinaryItem encode() {
064    // Encode the string to Base64
065    return IBase64BinaryItem.encode(asString());
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
070   *
071   * @param item
072   *          the item to cast
073   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
074   *         cast to this type
075   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
076   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
077   */
078  @NonNull
079  static IStringItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
080    try {
081      return item instanceof IStringItem
082          ? (IStringItem) item
083          : valueOf(item.asString());
084    } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
085      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
086      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
087    }
088  }
089
090  @Override
091  default IStringItem asStringItem() {
092    return this;
093  }
094
095  @Override
096  default IStringItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
097    return cast(item);
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Compares this value with the argument. Ordering is in lexical dictionary
102   * order.
103   *
104   * @param other
105   *          the item to compare with this value
106   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
107   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
108   */
109  default int compareTo(@NonNull IStringItem other) {
110    return asString().compareTo(other.asString());
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * An implementation of <a href=
115   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-normalize-space">fn::normalize-space</a>.
116   *
117   * @return the normalized string value for this string
118   */
119  @NonNull
120  IStringItem normalizeSpace();
121
122  /**
123   * Get the length of the string.
124   *
125   * @return the length
126   */
127  default int length() {
128    return asString().length();
129  }
130}
